title: Field Report: overnight alarm summary — Orchard Standpipe

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — RWTP Operations
fields.location: RWTP Control Room (review of Orchard Standpipe, 870 Orchard Road)
fields.summary: Overnight alarm summary shows ZS-612 (gate contact) open/close at 01:52 and 02:31, both acknowledged as wind by the night shift. RTU-02 reports the roof hatch closed, but ZS-611 has been out of service since 07/2024. A CAM-13 clip at 02:29 shows a figure with a flashlight at the edge of the frame walking from the gate toward the ladder cage.

recommendations: Send the Distribution on-call crew and request Millbrook Police

snapshot.title: Orchard Standpipe Gate Contact Trip — Field Report

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer
fields.inspector: RWTP Control Room Operator, Plant Operations
fields.summary: Reviewing the overnight RTU-02 event log for Orchard Standpipe, two gate contact trips were recorded: ZS-612 at 02:15 and 04:30. ZS-611 (hatch switch) remains inactive per MDWS-OTSEC-2026 Section 3 and WO-24-1187; RTU-02 continues to report the hatch as closed. CAM-13 video from 03:42 shows a person in dark clothing near the ladder cage, not visible at the gate. No system alarms, no feed or pressure changes. Proceeding to verify AIT-611 status.

findings.notes: Captured figure near ladder cage at 03:42
Reports hatch as closed; no fault logs
Unverified access point; figure observed near ladder cage
No changes in feed rates or residuals

actionsTaken: Reviewed RTU-02 event log for Orchard Standpipe
Timestamped and stored 12-second clip (03:42) on MBW-NVR-01
recommendations: Notify Security & Emergency Manager to secure site and contact Millbrook Police (555) 032-7000
Initiate field sampling at AIT-611 per ERP Section 8.3
Review PACS and CCTV archives for full site coverage
Assess need for temporary access barrier until site clearance
fields.photosNote: 1 video clip attached: CAM-13_0342_12sec (figure near ladder cage, dark clothing)
fields.signature: RWTP Control Room Operator, Plant Operations

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the physical intrusion and delayed detection. The team must act on the camera evidence and ZS-612 trips despite the hatch switch failure. Watch for the WQ Manager to request sampling and the Security Officer to contact law enforcement.
